title: Warranty Claim
description: Your product broke just after the warranty expired
initialPrompt: Добрый день, сервисный центр. Что у вас случилось?
systemPrompt: You work at service center. Customer laptop broke 2 weeks after warranty ended. Can offer goodwill repair at 50 percent discount or extended warranty for future. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User negotiated exception or accepted available options.
hints: Гарантия закончилась две недели назад (The warranty ended two weeks ago)
Это производственный дефект (This is a manufacturing defect)
Можно сделать исключение? (Can you make an exception?)
